title: Verb + noun collocations
instructions: Write the missing verb in the correct form.

items.q: We need to ______ a decision by Friday.
I'd like to ______ a complaint about the service.
The new policy will ______ more harm than good.
Could you ______ me a favour and water my plants?
Please ______ attention to the safety instructions.
Our team ______ significant progress this quarter.
The findings ______ serious questions about data privacy.
After hours of negotiation, they finally ______ an agreement.
It's hard to ______ a conclusion from such a small sample.
The product failed to ______ customer expectations.
Her speech ______ a lasting impression on the audience.
We ______ a big risk by launching the product so early.
He ______ his temper and started shouting.
Don't worry about the booking - I'll ______ care of it.
Could you ______ an eye on my bag for a minute?

title: Adjective + noun and adverb + adjective
instructions: Choose the most natural collocation. Type the letter or the word.

items.q: There was ___ traffic on the motorway this morning.
The ___ majority of respondents agreed with the proposal.
Losing the final was a ___ disappointment.
She has a ___ interest in politics.
We have ___ evidence that the new system works.
There's only a ___ chance of rain tomorrow.
He made a ___ effort to be polite.
The government is facing ___ criticism over the new law.
It's ___ knowledge that he's planning to retire.
My grandfather was a ___ smoker for forty years.
The festival was cancelled because of ___ rain.
The results of the two studies were ___ different.
I'm ___ aware of the risks involved.
She was ___ disappointed not to get the promotion.
The whole plan is ___ flawed; we need to start again.
It's ___ unlikely that they'll change their minds.

title: Collocations for ideas, data and change
instructions: Write ONE word in each gap.

items.q: The new research sheds ______ on the causes of the disease.
House prices rose ______ in 2022, by almost 20%.
There has been a ______ decline in birth rates over the past decade (slow and continuous).
Critics have ______ doubt on the reliability of the data.
We need to ______ a balance between speed and quality.
This decision could have far-______ consequences.
Better public education can help ______ the gap between rich and poor.
She ______ a very valid point about the budget.
His argument doesn't ______ water - the numbers don't add up.
Let's ______ into account the cost of training new staff.
The minister is under ______ pressure to resign.
There is ______ consensus among scientists on this issue.
The plan met with fierce ______ from local residents.
After rising for months, unemployment has finally levelled ______.
Sales ______ a peak in December and then fell sharply.

title: Collocations in context (a short report)
instructions: Read the report and write ONE word in each gap. Think about which words go together.

items.q: Over the past year, customer complaints have risen (1) ______ (= a lot, suddenly).
The survey (2) ______ light on the main reasons.
The (3) ______ majority of complaints relate to delivery times.
We have (4) ______ steps to address the problem, ...
... but we still need to (5) ______ a balance between speed and cost.
Management has (6) ______ concerns about the budget, ...
... and there is (7) ______ opposition from the sales team to any price increase.
It is (8) ______ unlikely that the problem will be solved this quarter.
However, the new system should (9) ______ a big difference by the summer.
We will continue to (10) ______ track of progress every month.

title: Upgrade the collocation
instructions: Replace the words in CAPITALS with a more natural or precise collocation (write only the replacement).

items.q: We have a VERY BIG problem with the supplier.
It's VERY IMPORTANT that we finish on time.
After the marathon I was VERY TIRED.
I'm VERY SURE that she's telling the truth.
A VERY LARGE NUMBER OF people signed the petition.
The project was VERY DIFFICULT but rewarding.
We need to THINK ABOUT the proposal CAREFULLY.
a: give careful consideration to the proposal

items.q: The two situations are VERY DIFFERENT.
Many people DISAGREE STRONGLY WITH the plan.
She gave a VERY GOOD reason for the delay.
